message.content: The RateLimiter in src/rateLimiter.ts is letting through more requests than it should under load. Can you find and fix the bug?

content.text: Let me look at the rate limiter first.
I'll run the tests to see the current failure before changing anything.
Found it: refill() divides the elapsed time by 1000 to get seconds, but under real load the clock returns milliseconds, so refill was 1000x too fast. Fixing the unit conversion.
